theme: Light theme primary. Dark theme toggle available but Light is default to emphasize freshness, outdoor accessibility, and transparency.

rules: No full-screen gradients. Use solid colors with noise texture.
Tint greys with a slight warm orange (sand) to keep it earthy.
Hover states must increase contrast and explicitly set text colors.

surfaces: Grid Borders (Technical Look): Use for Supplier data tables to enforce the concept of transparency (borders on right and bottom of cells).
Tactile Cards: Use solid backgrounds with 1px border for Farmer Dashboard cards. Avoid heavy shadows; keep it grounded and tactile.
NO glassmorphism on dense dashboards to prevent data refraction. Keep solid backgrounds to maintain contrast.
motion: Staggered entrance animations for incoming bids.
Micro-interactions: Buttons should slightly lift (-translate-y-1) on hover with a sharper shadow.
Use framer-motion for smooth list reordering when the 'Smart Auto Allocation' triggers.

layouts.farmer_dashboard: Mobile-first Bento Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8). Large tap targets and tactile buttons, heavily optimizing for outdoor mobile usage.
layouts.supplier_dashboard: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4). Every pixel utilized for bid comparisons. Incorporate sticky headers for wide data tables.
layouts.customer_marketplace: The Swiss Grid. Wide gap-8, asymmetrical product showcases emphasizing origin transparency.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy. Use p-6 or p-8 inside bordered containers to prevent text collision.

component_rules.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Strip default 'Vercel-look'. Use earthy borders and slightly larger text (text-base) for mobile input accessibility.
component_rules.tables: Use Shadcn Table. Dense, spreadsheet-like styling for reverse bidding views.
component_rules.charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn Charts for Market Price Trends. Style lines with earthy greens and terracotta.
component_rules.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for clean, premium duotone and regular weight icons.
component_rules.toasts: Use Sonner for notifications (e.g. 'Bid Submitted'). Position bottom-center for mobile.

farmers.description: Woman harvesting rice, authentic representation of grassroots farmers

produce.description: Green and red vegetables on wooden table

instructions_to_main_agent: Run: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react framer-motion recharts sonner
Implement multilingual support (English/Hindi) structurally using an i18n context so Farmers can easily toggle language.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to ALL interactive and key informational elements (e.g. data-testid='submit-bid-button').
Load 'Cabinet Grotesk' and 'Manrope' fonts via Fontshare or Google Fonts in index.css.
Ensure the reverse bidding table has clear sorting functionalities and highlights 'Smart Allocation' recommendations.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' UI. NEVER use Inter for headings. DO NOT use generic SaaS blue; use the provided earthy palette. Ensure all components have hover/active states with explicitly defined text colors. DO NOT use transparent backgrounds on headers, dropdowns, or overlays. DO NOT apply universal 'transition: all' in CSS. DO NOT center align the root .App container. Use high padding (p-6, p-8) to give content room to breathe.
